items.title: Amgen (NASDAQ:AMGN) exceeds Q3 2026 expectations, full-year outlook slightly exceeds expectations
items.summary: Biotech company Amgen (NASDAQ:AMGN) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, with revenue up 8.5% year on year to $10.37 billion. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $39.3 billion at the midpoint came in 0.8% above analysts’ consensus estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $6.45 per share was 11.6% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
